tools.name: dataset_licence
tools.description: Retrieve licence facts for one Hugging Face dataset: declared licence, where it was declared, recorded source datasets, detected licence files and a signal. Each licence value comes with an evidence URL linking to the Hub file, API record, file list or Hub page that was checked, with a commit-specif

tools.name: find_datasets
tools.description: Search the 5,000 most downloaded Hugging Face datasets in the daily build, returning matches in descending order of download count. Optionally filter by signal, task tag and declared licence ID; all supplied filters must match. Returns up to 50 results; licence_evidence links to the Hub file, API re

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dataset_licence · Private data: dataset_licence, find_datasets · Public sink: dataset_licence, find_datasets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dataset_licence · Private data: dataset_licence, find_datasets · Public sink: dataset_licence, find_datasets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dataset_licence" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
